harness: Existing promptfoo and Inspect upstream-supported evaluation paths; do not add another harness.

case_scope.oracle: Identical recorded outputs, mock tool responses and judge model on the 60 independently labeled cases, including wrong-ticker, look-ahead-date, missing-tool and grader-error mutations. Empty-output and externally-cancelled controls have distinct expected labels. Then add 20 independently labeled growth cases and test eval_set top-up without rerunning the original cases.

scenarios.rule: Reject missing cases or hidden errors/cancellations. Inspect joins or replaces only if it detects more injected mutations or correctly distinguishes empty/cancelled controls where Promptfoo does not, while preserving per-sample failure-localizing logs and running only the 20 growth cases during top-up. At detection/localization parity Promptfoo stays and Inspect remains keep_but_compare; compare complete provider USD only after the correctness criteria.
